exposure: Presence or absence of VTE risk factors
cohort: 850 pregnant women who underwent cesarean deliveries from August 3, 2020 to March 31, 2022
finding: A protocol utilizing unfractionated heparin followed by enoxaparin for VTE prophylaxis in women with VTE risk factors undergoing cesarean delivery was found to be effective and safe, with no cases of symptomatic VTE and only one case of major bleeding.
